name: dsh-expert-council-protocol-tests
description: Node >= 22 no longer expands a directory argument for `node --test`; it loads the path as a module. This package.json makes the documented acceptance command `node --test tests/protocols` run every *.test.js file in this directory via ./run-all.js. The individual files can also be run directly, e.g. `node --test "tests/protocols/*.test.js"`.
